runners_data.name: Greek Mythology

runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the second attempt in a C&D maiden last August (good); fair third in a rated race over an extended 7f at Roscommon; failed to get a clear run in a 6f Listed race at Fairyhouse, and his sixth placing can be upgraded; never got in a blow when joint-favourite for the 6f Birdcatcher Nursery.

runners_data.name: Neolithic
runners_data.note: Well-handicapped prominent racer who won over 6f at Naas and showed improved form in recent Gladness Stakes third
runners_data.comment: 6f winner at two, gave a lively display in the Gladness, sets a high standard here
runners_data.spotlight: Stepped up from his first two runs with a 6f win at Naas last July when wearing first-time cheekpieces; a revelation on his reappearance in the Gladness Stakes at the Curragh 11 days ago; belied his 28-1 odds (stablemate Albert Einstein 11-10 fav) with a prominent run, stuck to his task to finish third, splitting older horses rated 109 and 112.

races.paceDynamic: Greek Mythology will set the pace unopposed from the front, with Controlled, Neolithic, and Morehampton settling in behind as prominent runners. The lone leader will dictate terms on soft ground over 7f, creating a controlled tempo that builds gradually. With no genuine hold-up horses to provide late challenges and Greek Mythology able to control fractions, this race strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace from the outset.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Greek Mythology Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology gets an uncontested lead and maintains his action on soft ground.
scenarios.body: The lone pace-setter controls every fraction and has enough left to resist challenges in the straight. His fresh condition after 126 days off and proven 7f ability make him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Prominent Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes unsustainably fast or Greek Mythology stops.
scenarios.body: Neolithic or Controlled can capitalize from their prominent positions, having raced more recently and showing better current form. The winner comes from the pack of prominent runners tracking the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Controlled Improves Further
scenarios.trigger: If the Daniel Murphy-trained horse builds on his recent second and gets first run on the leader.
scenarios.body: His sharp 5f winning style translates well to tracking pace before quickening, and Shane Foley's 17-day freshness helps. Murphy's 1/7 strike rate this period adds confidence to the challenge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Greek Mythology goes too fast early or fails to handle the return from his long break.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair where any of the prominent runners can win in a sprint finish. Fitness and recent racing experience become decisive factors in a slowly-run contest.

watchPoints.text: Greek Mythology's fitness after 126-day break - any signs of rustiness early could end his front-running advantage
Neolithic's ability to settle kindly for Wayne Lordan rather than racing too keenly in prominent position
Controlled's tactical positioning with Shane Foley - needs to be close enough to use his 5f speed but not chase too hard
Early pace development - if Greek Mythology goes too fast the prominent runners all come into play late
Soft ground impact on stamina reserves over 7f - fresher horses may have advantage in testing conditions

races.paceDynamic: Unfamiliar is the sole confirmed front-runner and will set a sustainable pace without pressure through the early stages. The majority of this field consists of hold-up horses (Monocle Rocket, Cisterna, Andosky, Aurora Mist, Dream And Believe, Believe Believe, Survivor's Code, Beau Army, Lilo Pelekai) with only Nephin Mountain offering prominent tactics alongside the leader. This creates an ideal scenario where Unfamiliar can dictate terms while the large pack of hold-up horses will create traffic problems and require luck in running. The uncontested early pace and congested finish strongly favours front-running and prominent horses who can avoid the scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Unfamiliar Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Unfamiliar maintains a steady gallop and holds his kick for the final furlong
scenarios.body: The lone leader dictates ideal fractions while the massed hold-up horses struggle for room in a bunched finish. Prominent runners like Nephin Mountain benefit from tracking the pace without traffic issues.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Find Room
scenarios.trigger: If the large group of hold-up horses can secure clear passages in the straight
scenarios.body: Despite the tactical disadvantage, superior handicapping allows the better hold-up horses to overcome traffic concerns. The soft ground aids their staying power in the final stages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Unfamiliar goes too slowly and gets swamped by the field turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace creates a sprint finish that suits horses with tactical speed. Those with recent form and fitness advantages capitalize on the bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Finale
scenarios.trigger: If the large hold-up contingent creates significant interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Multiple horses get hampered in a messy finish, allowing an unconsidered runner with a clear run to emerge. The outsiders with nothing to lose benefit from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Unfamiliar breaks slowly or gets pressured early by Nephin Mountain, destroying the tactical advantage that makes him favourable
Aurora Mist and Dream And Believe get trapped behind horses in the straight as the large hold-up contingent creates traffic problems
Cisterna shows early pace despite hold-up style, indicating connections expect more aggressive tactics than recent running suggests
Andosky shows early sharpness despite long absence, suggesting the 223-day break has not dulled competitive edge
Nephin Mountain travels kindly behind Unfamiliar through the early stages despite 265-day layoff and apprentice jockey combination

races.paceDynamic: Incredible Army is the only confirmed front runner in this 9-runner field, setting up a scenario where he can dictate terms unopposed through the early stages on soft ground. With the majority of the field comprised of hold-up horses (Coincidental Glory, Captive Beauty, Clonbun, Green Testimony, Kactus Jack, Femme Beauty, Balance Of Trade), there will be minimal early pressure on the leader. However, Incredible Army has shown a tendency to fade in the finish, creating a tactical race where patient riders can time their challenges from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the leader without getting involved in early speed battles, and hold-up horses with strong finishing kicks who can exploit the likely collapse of the lone front runner.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Incredible Army gets an easy lead and finds more stamina on turf debut
scenarios.body: The soft ground and lack of early pressure allows him to control fractions and potentially last home despite his fading tendencies. His recent Dundalk win suggests he has some ability when things fall right.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes unsustainable or Incredible Army fades as expected
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Coincidental Glory and Green Testimony pay dividends as they can unleash finishing kicks from off the pace. Soft ground suits both and the race sets up perfectly for their preferred running styles.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses adopts more aggressive tactics to sit closer
scenarios.body: A horse like Kactus Jack or Balance Of Trade positions themselves to track the leader and strikes when Incredible Army weakens. This tactical switch catches the deep closers off guard in a slowly run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Incredible Army stops quickly and no one is positioned to capitalize
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between multiple hold-up horses who all get there at once. Form and class become the deciding factors rather than tactics.

watchPoints.text: Incredible Army's turf debut and stamina limitations - if he fades quickly the race becomes chaotic
Coincidental Glory's 112-day absence could leave him short of peak fitness despite recent good form
Track the early positioning of hold-up horses - any that get closer than usual could gain significant tactical advantage
Monitor the pace through the first half-mile - if it's genuinely slow even Incredible Army might last longer
Watch for market moves on Captive Beauty and Green Testimony who both have scope for improvement

races.paceDynamic: Thrifty Of Digby is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner field, which should allow her to dictate terms without early pressure. Independent Expert and Fast Tara will likely track in prominent positions, with Electric Beauty also forward, but the majority of this field are hold-up performers including Never Loose, Greydreambeliever, Sindria, and Angelight. The soft ground at 1m will create a searching test from the 2f pole, putting emphasis on stamina over speed. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can benefit from the uncontested early pace and deliver their challenge late when the leaders tire on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate through halfway allowing closers to unleash late runs
scenarios.body: The soft ground saps the early leaders from 2f out while fresh finishers sweep past in the final 150 yards. Multiple hold-up horses benefit from the race shape with Never Loose and Sindria best positioned to capitalize.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Expert or Electric Beauty can position ideally behind the leader without doing too much work
scenarios.body: They get first run on the tiring Thrifty Of Digby and hold off the late charge on ground that suits their proven stamina. Recent form and fitness gives them the edge over returning runners.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustainable Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby's two course wins translate to perfect tactical positioning and the soft ground doesn't stop her
scenarios.body: She sets an even gallop that suits her stamina strengths and kicks clear before the closers can organize their challenge. Her proven course form becomes decisive on testing ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely allowing a rank outsider to emerge from the pack
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from 3f out where one of the forgotten horses finds a clear run and superior finishing speed. Class levels drop dramatically in a muddling contest.

races.paceDynamic: Talk Show Host and Ethereal Star are the only confirmed front-runners in this 14-runner field, but both carry warning flags for fading in the finish which could create an honest but not overly taxing early gallop. The soft ground and 1m1½f trip will stretch stamina reserves, particularly for those that race prominently early. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics, the pace is likely to be steady rather than fierce, building gradually through the middle sections. This race shape strongly favors hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the early leaders may not have the stamina to sustain their effort on testing ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is honest but not fierce with Talk Show Host and Ethereal Star settling the tempo
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a stamina test where late-running types can use their superior fitness and tactical positioning to overwhelm the early leaders in the final two furlongs. Horses like Zipster and Justenzia, both proven on soft ground with strong finishing kicks, will benefit most from this patient tactical approach.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Ohmali can secure an ideal prominent position just behind the leaders without doing too much work
scenarios.body: The pace will quicken gradually allowing those racing in the first four to maintain their position while the hold-up horses struggle to make ground on the testing surface. This scenario requires the early pace to be genuinely strong enough to stretch the field but not so fast that the prominent runners empty their tanks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Surprises
scenarios.trigger: If either Talk Show Host or Ethereal Star shows improved stamina and the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: One of the leaders will steal a march by maintaining a steady rhythm while the field gets strung out behind, allowing them to build an unassailable advantage. The soft ground could play to their favor if they can ration their effort more effectively than their previous runs suggest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the combination of soft ground, long absence, and fitness concerns creates multiple non-performances from the fancied runners
scenarios.body: The race will become a lottery where horses returning from breaks or stepping up significantly in trip find the conditions too demanding. This opens the door for unfancied runners with recent race fitness and proven ability to handle the ground conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Nancee Spain is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, but her tendency to fade in the finish on soft ground creates a vulnerable pace scenario. The prominent runners Zanahiyr, Light Up The Dark, and Not Just Any Eagle will track her early, while the strong contingent of hold-up horses including Slurricane, Harry's Legacy, Rich Belief, and Katherine will be positioned for late challenges. With one pacemaker against multiple closers over this stamina-testing 1m6f trip on energy-sapping soft ground, this race strongly favours hold-up horses who can capitalise on Nancee Spain's expected late fade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If Nancee Spain sets steady fractions but fades as expected in the final two furlongs.
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade get perfect positioning as the pace collapses, with stamina and class telling in the soft conditions. Slurricane and Rich Belief are perfectly suited to this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Light Up The Dark and Zanahiyr press Nancee Spain early and kick clear turning for home.
scenarios.body: The two classiest prominent runners use their tactical speed to get first run on the field before the closers can respond. Their superior ratings and form give them the edge in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Nancee Spain goes too slow early, allowing multiple horses to remain in contention.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates a bunched field turning in, leading to a tactical scramble where experience counts. Plunkett Street and God Of Thunder benefit from their versatility and jockey strength.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Nancee Spain gets an uncontested lead and finds improvement back on favoured soft ground.
scenarios.body: Despite her fading tendency, the mare gets perfect conditions to showcase her staying power without early pressure. Her class from that 15-length Roscommon win emerges under these ideal circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Nancee Spain's early fractions will be crucial - if she goes too fast early her fade becomes inevitable, if too slow she invites pressure.
Watch Light Up The Dark's market moves as any significant support would suggest readiness to fire fresh for powerful Joseph O'Brien yard.
Zanahiyr's positioning behind Nancee Spain matters hugely - needs to avoid getting too close early given his prominent style on this soft ground.
Rich Belief's weight advantage at 128lbs could be decisive if his class returns, making his early positioning crucial to monitor.
The 5lb and 7lb apprentice claims on Zanahiyr and Not Just Any Eagle respectively become more significant over this stamina-testing distance.
